title: Improving Implicit Hate Speech Detection via a Community-Driven Multi-Agent Framework
findings: The proposed community-driven multi-agent framework (Agentic) significantly improved the detection of implicit hate speech against Jewish and Muslim groups compared to baseline prompting methods (zero-shot, few-shot, CoT). For both groups, the Agentic approach achieved the highest balanced accuracy (bACC) and F1 scores, demonstrating enhanced fairness and effectiveness in identifying harmful content targeting these religious communities.
